supervisor.value: You must discuss supervision with at least one researcher before applying (applications without this are unlikely to be considered), and are strongly encouraged to secure a supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Prior to submitting an application, you must discuss potential supervision with at least one researcher. | Applicants are strongly encouraged to secure a supervisor prior to applying.

funding.value: You are automatically considered for funding (TA, research stipend, scholarships) when you apply; any offer comes with the admission letter, with no guaranteed amount stated.
funding.quote: When submitting an application for admission to Carleton, students are automatically considered for funding and if eligible, will be notified in the Offer of Admission and Funding.

entry_route.quote: An M.Sc. from an appropriate university is usually required for entry to the Ph.D. program.
